document_context.paragraph: City of Edmonton, Guideline for Alternative Solutions Affecting Emergency Services (April 2025). These submissions are peer-reviewed by Safety Codes, Permits and Inspections together with Edmonton Fire Rescue Services.

document_context.label: City of Calgary, building advisories, bulletins and Standing Posted Variances
document_context.paragraph: City of Calgary, building advisories, bulletins and Standing Posted Variances. Calgary publishes Standing Posted Variances (SPVs) that any builder can reference on a permit rather than applying individually — currently covering backwater valves, firewalls in rowhouses with secondary suites, exposed building face construction, ventilation, and zero lot line. The procedure exists because 26 builders were filing the same zero lot line variance repeatedly: 382 requests in eight months of 2017, each separately written, issued and forwarded to the Safety Codes Council.
